name: Nettspend
description:
'''Gunner Shepardson''' (born 2007), known professionally as '''Nettspend''', is an American rapper from [[Richmond, Virginia]]. He is credited with the popularization of a more extreme and experimental version of [[Rage (music genre)|rage]] music, alongside artists such as [[OsamaSon]], and [[Che (rapper)|Che]].

Nettspend began rapping while in fifth grade and began uploading to [[SoundCloud]] in October 2022. In 2023, Nettspend released his breakthrough single "Drankdrankdrank," which went viral across [[Twitter]]. Following a slew of releases and his rise to fame, Nettspend released his debut studio mixtape ''[[Bad Ass F*cking Kid]]'' in 2024. It became his first project to chart on the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]], debuting at number 198.

Nettspend released his debut [[studio album]] titled ''[[Early Life Crisis]]'' on February 13, 2026. It became his second project to chart on the ''Billboard'' 200, debuting at number 39. Shortly afterwards, Nettspend released a [[compilation album]] titled ''Him''. It was released exclusively on SoundCloud on April 30 before it was released on all streaming platforms on July 3. On October 30, 2026, Nettspend released his debut commercial [[EP]] ''[[Virginia Creeper (EP)|Virginia Creeper]]''.
